community_pulse: The community is wrestling with three competing conversations: budget constraints pushing people toward cheaper carnivore options, health concerns around LDL cholesterol creating doubt, and heated debates over fat intake and meal frequency. Dr. Elizabeth Bright's viral video sparked the week's biggest engagement around avoiding beginner mistakes.

topics.title: The Butter Wars: How Much Fat Should You Actually Eat on Carnivore?
topics.angle: Cut through the OMAD vs. frequent eating debate by breaking down fat intake by metabolic goal (fat loss vs. performance vs. maintenance) instead of one-size-fits-all advice
topics.why_now: Dr. Bright's video ignited a comments section full of conflicting fat advice; people need a practical framework, not ideology

topics.title: LDL on Carnivore: What the Recent Studies Actually Say (vs. What You're Hearing)
topics.angle: Address the LDL anxiety by distinguishing between particle size, apoB, and context — not just raw LDL numbers — with recent 2025-2026 research cited
topics.why_now: LDL cholesterol is trending because people are scared; this defuses panic with real data

topics.title: Carnivore on $50/Week: The Budget Breakdown That Actually Works
topics.angle: Get specific with chicken thighs, organ meats, and eggs — show real meal plans and sourcing hacks instead of vague 'buy cheap cuts' advice
topics.why_now: Budget carnivore is trending on YouTube; people want to know HOW, not just that it's possible

topics.title: I Watched the Critics' Latest Carnivore Attack. Here's What They Got Wrong.
topics.angle: Steelman the criticism (don't strawman), then systematically dismantle bad arguments while acknowledging legitimate concerns about muscle loss or nutrient gaps
topics.why_now: Critics vs. Carnivore is trending; the community wants ammunition, but credibility comes from fair debate

topics.title: Electrolytes on Carnivore: The Dosing Math Nobody Explains Right
topics.angle: Provide actual sodium/potassium/magnesium targets based on activity level and sweat rate, not just 'add more salt' — include how to test if you're actually deficient
topics.why_now: Electrolytes balancing act is trending; people know it matters but don't know the specifics

topics.title: Keto to Carnivore: What Actually Changes (And What Dr. Bright Got Right)
topics.angle: Map the specific metabolic and practical shifts — fat ratio, fiber withdrawal, appetite suppression timeline — so people know what to expect in weeks 1-4
topics.why_now: Keto to Carnivore Transition is trending; people want a roadmap tied to Bright's viral insights

topics.title: The Carnivore Mistake Audit: What Dr. Bright Missed in 7 Minutes
topics.angle: Expand on Bright's framework by adding 3-4 mistakes she didn't mention (sleep, timing of salt, overeating when stressed) — honest, not dismissive
topics.why_now: Dr. Bright's video is the week's biggest moment; response content now will ride that wave

topics.title: Heart Surgeon vs. Carnivore: What HomesteadHow's Video Revealed
topics.angle: Discuss the framing challenge of doctor testimonials — why one surgeon's blessing doesn't prove the diet, but also why dismissing all doctors isn't the answer either
topics.why_now: The HomesteadHow heart surgeon story is trending but the post cut off in the signal; community wants perspective on doctor credibility

topics.title: Carnivore Performance: How to Structure Eating Around Workouts (Not Against It)
topics.angle: Practical timing and portions for strength training vs. endurance vs. casual activity — uses the OMAD debate as springboard but answers the real question
topics.why_now: Fat intake debate often includes performance questions; give people the actionable version

topics.title: Why People Quit Carnivore in Week 3 (And How to Actually Get Past It)
topics.angle: Tied to 'mistakes' trend but focus on the emotional/social wall, not just nutrition — loneliness, family pushback, food boredom — with solutions
topics.why_now: Mistake-focused content is resonating; expand beyond technical mistakes to behavioral ones
